title: Security posture
intro: The Pod Security Standards (Baseline and Restricted, as of Kubernetes v1.37) checked on the pod templates of workloads and on Pods that no workload owns, with hardening hints that are not part of the standard. Nothing is changed in the cluster: a suggested fix is copied as YAML, a strategic merge patch in which containers and volumes are matched by name.
